ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent Fire TV Stick 4K Max bundle already covers streaming, so I have little reason to add this model.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick with Alexa Voice Remote, streaming media player - Previous Generation; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This overlaps with my recently purchased 4K Max and offers no clear benefit for my setup.
ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: With my recent Echo Dot and Echo Show purchases, I would try controlling a lamp through Alexa.
ItemID: NA; Title: Panasonic ErgoFit Wired Earbuds, In-Ear Headphones with Microphone and Call Controller, Ergonomic Custom-Fit Earpieces (S/M/L), 3.5mm Jack for Phones and Laptops - RP-TCM125-A (Blue); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am focused on home electronics and computer accessories right now, with no current need for wired earbuds.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo (2nd Generation) - Smart speaker with Alexa and Dolby processing - Charcoal Fabric; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I recently added a newer Echo Dot and Echo Show, so another older Echo feels redundant.
ItemID: NA; Title: Seagate Expansion Portable 2TB External Hard Drive HDD – USB 3.0 for PC Laptop (STEA2000400) , black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: A portable drive could complement my existing desktop backup drive for moving files and keeping another backup.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire HD 10 Tablet with Alexa Hands-Free, 10.1" 1080p Full HD Display, 32 GB, Marine Blue (Previous Generation - 7th); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no clear tablet need right now, and Alexa access is already covered by my Echo devices.
ItemID: NA; Title: SABRENT 4 Port USB 2.0 Data Hub with Individual LED lit Power Switches [Charging NOT Supported] for Mac & PC (HB-UMLS); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recently purchased card reader already adds USB 3.0 ports, making this USB 2.0 hub a low priority.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I recently purchased a fourth-generation Echo Dot, so I would pass on this older version.
ItemID: NA; Title: OontZ Angle 3 Bluetooth Speaker, Portable Wireless Bluetooth 5.0 Speaker, 10 Watts, Crystal Clear Stereo Sound, Rich Bass, IPX5 Water Resistant, Loud Portable Bluetooth Speaker (Black); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have an Amazon Tap and several Echo devices, with no immediate need for another Bluetooth speaker.
